Maria (CS): Heads-up — VerityDocs just spun up two new teams this week: a catalog ingestion pipeline and an internal QA bot fleet. Seeing sustained traffic spikes. Can we get a capacity/forecast + impact on renewal?
Hari (CSM): When did the QA bots go live and what are the quick numbers?
Maria (CS): QA bots started Wed morning. Before: ~120 qps embedding calls. Peak yesterday: ~420 qps sustained for ~30m. Catalog batch jobs are ~250k tokens/run, 2 runs/day.
Olivia (Analytics): Confirming telemetry: 3.8x token volume increase last 48h, median latency 280ms -> 430ms on some routes. Top models in use: open-llama-7b (gen), text-embedding-ada (embeds), llm-config shows batch_size=64 on ingestion.
Ethan (SE): Recommend we propose a short Dedicated pilot (2x A100 equiv GPUs) + canary routing for 72h. If they need lower latency for QA, suggest model pinning to 7b-quant. Example canary cfg:
```
route: verity-qa
model: open-llama-7b-quant
batching: {max_tokens: 4096, batch_size: 32}
quota: {rate_limit: 1000/min}
```
Hari (CSM): This looks like an upsell but also a renewal risk if latencies keep rising. Need enablement docs + training for their SREs.
Tara (Product): Also capture feedback: are they hitting any quality regressions with quantized models for QA? Olivia, can you add prompt evals?
Olivia (Analytics): On it — I'll push a short eval harness and baseline pass/fail metrics into their workspace. Will track answer F1 + hallucination rate.
Robin (SRE): I can carve a 2-GPU dedicated pool for a 2-week pilot. Autoscale off, reserve throughput for their routes. Need PO and SSO access for their infra engineer.
Maria (CS): Client asked for a forecast by EOD tomorrow. Who owns the cost estimate + playbook?
Ethan (SE): I'll run a usage sim tonight. Preliminary back-of-envelope: sustained 3.5x tokens -> ~+$6k/mo on hosted; Dedicated pilot cost TBD but predictable. Will post numbers in this thread.
Robin (SRE): Also note fallback policy: route->regional-hosted during exhaustion; can enable prefix KV caching for catalog ingestion to cut tokens ~30%.
Hari (CSM): I'll schedule a 30m kickoff with VerityDocs eng lead (suggest 10:30am PT tomorrow). I'll also flag this to Renewals if sustained >2x for 2 weeks.
deploy-bot: canary-resources created for veritydocs-2gpu at 2026-03-21T15:42Z :white_check_mark:
Maria (CS): :thumbsup: Thanks team. Next actions: Ethan cost estimate, Robin provisioning + PO, Olivia eval harness, Hari kickoff. Will update thread after the kickoff.
